newsitem.title: FRANCE: Casino not mulling Promodes alliance-paper.
newsitem.headline: Casino not mulling Promodes alliance-paper.

text.p: The chairman of French hypermarkets group Casino said in a newspaper interview on Thursday that an alliance with retailer Promodes was not inevitable and that Casino was not currently studying such an option.

Chairman Georges Plassat told Les Echos a linkup between the two, the subject of recurring rumours on the bourse, "is not inevitable. There's no obligation or urgency...As far as Promodes is concerned, we're not currently studying terms of a linkup". But he did not rule out an eventual deal with a rival.
Plassat said the annual turnover of Casino and its partners was close to 100 billion francs.
